rationale: Multiple HN threads and community discussions document teams losing hours or money when LLM providers silently degrade model quality mid-production, with no proactive alerting from providers. Adjacent paid observability tooling (Datadog, PagerDuty, Langfuse) confirms this segment pays for automated monitoring. At least one competitor (Langfuse) charges $49–$299/month for LLM observability, validating willingness to pay for a narrower canary-probing product.
